title: Apply test-run and Work page budgets before whole-index materialization and client page draining
outcome: Test-run and Work browsing retain bounded server and client working sets using the existing paged APIs.
acceptance: Test-run list filtering/paging occurs without cloning all summaries and includes a byte budget for nested stage/error/history data; state integration coordinates live projection work.
UI consumes existing paged test-run and Engram Work APIs on demand without draining all pages into one list; loading/search completeness is explicit.
Reuse Work transport8MiB cap, existing proposed Engram page-bytes integration and current test log/card bounds; no duplicate paging protocol.
Tests cover many records with bounded pages, filters and continuation, and independently reviewed/full-gated implementation.
